author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be Palantir and their recently released unhinged manifesto. This company is normalizing mass surveillance and they're getting more powerful as each day passes. It's time to understand what they are and why we need to push back. Thanks for watching!
